TC-15/S04.title: Preset 'urgent pending tasks' with one flagged task (Hospital; Nursing Home variant)
TC-15/S04.detail: Dev, build e02167f, agent unit U85 (devSpec of TC-15/S04). Preset "Any urgent pending tasks?" asked once on each seeded chart (each chart: one open task flagged urgent, one open unflagged, one done). The oracle's substring checks passed (flagged task named, done task absent; Q2 record: the unflagged task was listed too), but the answer is wrong on the Nursing Home chart: it says "there are no urgent tasks documented" and lists the flagged task "Recheck weight Friday" as "routine follow-up, not time-sensitive" next to the unflagged one. Judged against U1 (each preset returns a correct, patient-specific answer; then: the answer names the flagged open task), so failed on the Nursing Home half. Hospital half: "Call ID re: blood cultures today" was called urgent and "Repeat chest X-ray tomorrow" non-urgent, which matches the flags, but only by inference from 'today' / 'tomorrow'. Cause (code reading, the review's Q2 candidate): the Ask context sends the pending tasks as text only and drops the urgent flag in both contexts (src/features/rounding/patient/askContext.ts:115-118; the Nursing Home ask uses the same builder), so the model cannot know which task the physician flagged. Also recorded for Preston (3.4): added clinical reasoning ("the blood culture follow-up is the priority to guide antibiotic therapy") and documentation-status narration. T4 (the 3.2 grade, EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md) belongs to TFA-94229 (in progress): todo, not judged. Rows: 2 deleted, 0 left, no other row changed.
TC-15/S04.productIssue: Asked 'Any urgent pending tasks?' on a Nursing Home resident with a task the physician flagged urgent ('Recheck weight Friday'), Ask AI answers that there are no urgent tasks and calls that task routine and not time-sensitive. The urgent flag never reaches the model (task text only), so any answer about urgency is a guess.
